title: Vishwanath Shukla
text:
Research

Quantum many-body dynamics
Non-equilibrium dynamics, thermalization and prethermal phases in driven quantum systems, including Rydberg atom chains.


Classical and quantum fluids
Turbulence, irreversibility and non-equilibrium statistical properties of classical fluids, Bose–Einstein condensates and superfluids. My work includes the Navier–Stokes and Gross–Pitaevskii equations, rotating flows and particle dynamics.


Active matter
Collective dynamics of self-propelled particles in dry systems and fluid environments.


Physics and computing
Numerical simulations and high-performance computing to study complex physical systems.
